title: Accurate job descriptions aid return to work
primary_angle: Accurate and updated job descriptions are essential for successful return-to-work programs.
rationale: This angle highlights GB's expertise in workers' compensation and the importance of accurate job descriptions, aligning with our focus on improving outcomes for clients and injured workers.

posts.angle: The importance of updated job descriptions in return-to-work programs.
posts.text: Are your job descriptions current? Keeping them updated is crucial for effective return-to-work programs. Outdated descriptions can signal potential struggles, and even with accurate ones, communication can still break down. Employers are now enhancing descriptions with photos, videos, and predictive analytics. Read Irina Simpson's insights in Business Insurance: https://www.businessinsurance.com/accurate-job-descriptions-aid-return-to-work/

posts.angle: The critical role of job descriptions in return-to-work programs.
posts.text:
In my latest discussion with Business Insurance, I emphasized how vital it is to keep job descriptions up-to-date, as they play a crucial role in return-to-work programs. Outdated descriptions often indicate potential issues, and communication can still falter even with accurate information. Employers are now using photos, videos, and AI to improve outcomes. It's an exciting time for innovation in this field.

https://www.businessinsurance.com/accurate-job-descriptions-aid-return-to-work/

posts.text:
